body: Standing instruction from Brian via the Mac window hall9k-a7 at 2026-09-24 21:24 EDT: when the cut that carries hall9k#586 (1cccd3f7, the leader rule) is installed on Windows, run h9k config set --auto-pr-review-mint-hold 0 there and stop/start the daemon so it binds, then report. Zero means Windows never defers to the Mac (which sorts first and has arx-platform off), so arx-platform reviews mint on Windows on the first sweep as today. The knob does not exist before that cut; do nothing until it lands. I will name the tag in the cut post.
